tags.db.query.text: select "tm"."base_id" as "baseId", "tm"."name" as "tableName", "f"."id" as "fieldId", "f"."name" as "fieldName", "f"."options" as "fieldOptions" from "table_meta" as "tm" inner join "field" as "f" on "tm"."id" = "f"."table_id" and "tm"."deleted_time" is null and "f"."deleted_time" is null where "f"."table_id" = 'tblKH9RAxWvtx9wwPrM' and "f"."type" = 'user'

tags.db.query.text: SELECT "public"."field"."id" FROM "public"."field" WHERE ("public"."field"."table_id" = $1 AND "public"."field"."type" = $2 AND "public"."field"."is_lookup" IS NULL AND "public"."field"."deleted_time" IS NULL) OFFSET $3
tags.otel.scope.name: prisma

tags.db.query.text:
select "ws"."id" as "id", "ws"."workflow_id" as "workflowId", ws.snapshot->>'baseId' as "baseId", (
            SELECT elem
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(ws.snapshot->'nodes') elem
            WHERE elem->>'category' = 'trigger'
            LIMIT 1
          ) as "trigger" from "workflow" as "w" inner join "workflow_snapshot" as "ws" on "w"."active_snapshot_id" = "ws"."id" where "w"."is_active" = true and "w"."subscribe_resource_id" = 'tblKH9RAxWvtx9wwPrM' and "w"."subscribe_trigger_type" in ('recordCreated', 'recordUpdated', 'recordCreatedOrUpdated', 'recordMatchesConditions', 'formSubmitted', 'buttonClick') and "w"."deleted_time" is null
tags.otel.scope.name: prisma
